entities.summary: Royal Noble Consort Su of the Bannam Park clan was a concubine of Jeongjo of Joseon and the mother of King Sunjo. Her posthumous honorific "綏" was originally pronounced "yu" (유) in the 19th century, hence her posthumous title was once Royal Noble Consort Yu.
